newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen sees no Paribas link - interview.
newsitem.headline: SocGen sees no Paribas link - interview.

text.p: Societe Generale chairman Marc Vienot said in an interview to be published on Thursday he did not have a tie-up with Paribas in mind and doubted Paribas did either, given the overlaps it would involve and the differences of culture.
"You can dream about it," he was quoted as saying in reply to a question in the interview in Les Echos newspaper, a copy of which was supplied in advance to Reuters.

"It would not be a nightmare but it would be very difficult. Because even if there could be complementarities in France, we are each on our own account the two most developed French banks internationally," he was quoted as saying.
"That would result in a lot of overlap. Our cultures are not the same either. Overall, I believe (Paribas chairman) Andre Levy-Lang, like us, has not got this in mind. You should ask him," he added.
Societe Generale announced last week that it was in talks on a speedy purchase of Credit du Nore from Paribas for 2.2 billion francs.
